title: Oh My NFT
tagline: NFT Marketplace on Matic with transfers to Ethereum
description: NFT Marketplace for creators and buyers on Matic with transfers to Ethereum. Artists just don't have the funds to create dozens if not hundreds of NFT's to a marketplace on Ethereum, we propose moving the minting process to Matic sidechain with the ability to move to Ethereum. Similar to Nifty.ink.
how_its_made:
Built on top on 🏗 Scaffold-Eth using Matic Mumbai testnet for deployment and testing. Using IPFS for all media uri's to prevent malicious tampering. By creating a simple UI for the artist's to mint their NFT's at a very low cost we can help grow the communities they belong to. 



Hope to see future integration with OpenSea on Matic.
